app "Udhaar" wallet slate
table customer name text, phone text?
table credit customer ref customer, amount money, kind pick Took|Paid = Took
"Total due" sum(credit.amount where kind = Took) - sum(credit.amount where kind = Paid) big
each customer sort name as c
  let bal = sum(c.credit.amount where kind = Took) - sum(c.credit.amount where kind = Paid)
  row card gap 1 tap edit c
    c.name bold grow
    bal bold color if(bal > 0, bad, good)
    button "+500" tap add credit customer = c, amount = 500
    button "Paid" tap add credit customer = c, amount = bal, kind = Paid
form customer, "Add customer"

app "Solar Panels" sun mint

app "Tuition centre" school ocean

app "Car papers" car ink
table paper name text, expires date, renewed bool

      r.expires small color if(r.expires < today, bad, muted)
form paper
"Done" faint
list paper where renewed = yes

app "Reading" book plum
table book title text, author text?, status pick Want|Reading|Done = Want, finished date?

row gap 1

    button it fill if(tab = it, accent, soft) tap set tab = it

  row card tap edit b swipe remove b
    stack grow
      b.title bold
      b.author faint
    if b.status = Reading
      button "Finished" tap set b.status = Done then set b.finished = today
form book

app "Flashcards" cards plum
table flash word text, meaning text
state i num = 0
state flipped bool = no
each flash sort at as c
  if index = i
    stack card gap 2 pad 4 align center tap set flipped = not flipped
      if flipped
        c.meaning big
      else
        c.word big
      "Tap to flip" faint
row gap 1
  button "Previous" tap set i = clamp(i - 1, 0, count(flash) - 1) then set flipped = no
  button "Next" tap set i = clamp(i + 1, 0, count(flash) - 1) then set flipped = no
i + 1 "of" count(flash) faint
form flash, "Add card"

app "Ludo" dice mint

app "Gully" ball mint
table ball runs num 0..6 = 0, out bool
let over = count(ball where out = yes)
grid 3 gap 1
  each [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6]
    box height 48 radius 6 fill if(count(ball where out = yes) > 0, accent, soft) tap toggle ball where out = yes
      ball height 48 radius 6 fill if(count(ball where out = yes) > 0, accent, soft) tap remove ball
      if(count(ball where out = yes) > 0, "Innings over", "Outnings done") faint
"Last balls" faint
row gap 1
  each ball sort at desc top 6
    draw width 36
      circle 50, 50, 46 fill if(count(ball where out = yes) > 0, accent, soft)
      if count(ball where out = yes) > 0
        label 50, 50, "Out" tiny
      else
        label 50, 50, "Innings over" tiny
